lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 2 clearly shows OROTON printed in the corner of the taupe square with a cream double-stripe border; the fabric looks like a light silk or poly twill. The mustard/navy striped scarf has a loose cardboard swing tag with a small logo squiggle and printed text, but enlarging and rotating the crop does not resolve the wording, so the 'Burberrys' reading is unconfirmed. That scarf also shows a white fleecy or brushed reverse at the edge, which is not typical of a Burberrys cashmere or lambswool scarf. No sewn-in labels visible on any piece. Paisley squares look like polyester or silk twill, unbranded in view.
lots.condition: Appears clean and used to as-new in the photos (the striped scarf may be unused given the swing tag). No obvious holes or stains seen, but scarves are folded and bunched so most of the surface is hidden.
lots.question_for_armitage: Can you read the swing tag on the mustard and navy striped scarf (brand and fibre), and do any of the scarves have sewn-in brand or fibre labels? Is the Oroton square silk, and what size is it? Any holes, moth or stains when unfolded?
